hooks.name: Protect my Kiro log
hooks.description:
docs/kiro-log.md is written by hand, in my own words. Kiro appended entries to it three times despite a steering rule, so this checks every write before it happens.

Migration note: Tool categories were converted to the tool-name matcher `^(fs_write|fs_append|str_replace|delete_file|code)$`, reconstructed from the built-in tool list. Confirm it covers the tools you meant, then enable the hook.

action.prompt: If this write targets docs/kiro-log.md, do not perform it. Reply that the log is written by hand by the project owner and move on without editing it. If it targets any other file, continue normally.
